Furthermore,  the  camel  has  a  higher  body  temperature than (425)______ of most mammals. This means that it starts to sweat (426)_______ a higher temperature than that which human beings,  for  example, (427)_______ to perspire. This also helps it to keep water loss through sweating to a minimal.

- Q.424.
- (a) a          (b) which    (c) very          (d) the
- Q.425. (a) some   (b) the        (c) that          (d) all
